pauseWallpaperOnFullscreen.title: Pause Wallpaper on Fullscreen
pauseWallpaperOnFullscreen.description: Pause video wallpapers while a fullscreen window covers the monitor

pauseWallpaperWhenCovered.title: Pause Wallpaper When Covered
pauseWallpaperWhenCovered.description: Pause video wallpapers while windows cover every pixel of the monitor (no gaps, e.g. monocle)

x-settings.label: system.performance.pause_wallpaper_covered
x-settings.keywords: video wallpaper covered tiled windows gaps monocle pause

pauseWallpaperOnIdle.title: Pause Wallpaper When Idle
pauseWallpaperOnIdle.description: Pause video wallpapers while you are away (no input and nothing inhibiting idle)

x-settings.label: system.performance.pause_wallpaper_idle
x-settings.keywords: video wallpaper idle away afk inactive pause

pauseWallpaperIdleDelay.title: Idle Pause Delay
pauseWallpaperIdleDelay.description: Seconds without input before the video wallpaper pauses

x-settings.label: system.performance.pause_wallpaper_idle_delay
x-settings.keywords: video wallpaper idle delay seconds timeout pause

pauseWallpaperOnBattery.title: Pause Wallpaper on Battery
pauseWallpaperOnBattery.description: Pause video wallpapers while the laptop runs on battery

x-settings.label: system.performance.pause_wallpaper_battery
x-settings.keywords: video wallpaper battery power laptop unplugged pause

videoWallpaperDownscale.title: Downscale Video Wallpapers
videoWallpaperDownscale.description: Play a cached copy scaled to the screen at up to 30 fps when the video is larger (made once with ffmpeg)

x-settings.label: system.performance.video_downscale
x-settings.keywords: video wallpaper downscale resolution transcode ffmpeg cpu fps 4k

dashboardPersistTabs.title: Persist Dashboard Tabs
dashboardPersistTabs.description: Keep dashboard tabs loaded after leaving them: faster switching, more memory.

dashboardMaxPersistentTabs.title: Tabs kept loaded
dashboardMaxPersistentTabs.description: Most dashboard tabs kept in memory at once.

unloadIdleViews.title: Release idle tabs
unloadIdleViews.description: Unload kept-loaded dashboard tabs a minute after the dashboard closes.

x-settings.label: prefs.sys.unload_idle_views
x-settings.keywords: dashboard tabs memory unload idle release
